sentences.en: The chocolate cake tempted her even though she was dieting.
sentences.zh: 尽管她在节食，这块巧克力蛋糕还是诱惑了她。

sentences.en: We need flour, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
sentences.zh: 我们需要面粉、糖和鸡蛋来制作这个蛋糕。

sentences.en: You cannot have your cake and eat it, too.
sentences.zh: 你不能既要（占着）又要吃掉。

senses.zh: 饼，糕，蛋糕，块状物，小菜一碟(容易做成的事)
涂厚厚的一层，覆盖，填满
